paras: The white-striped forest rail (Rallicula leucospila), also white-striped forest crake is a species of bird in the family Sarothruridae.  It is endemic to West Papua, Indonesia.  Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.  It is threatened by habitat loss.
